content.short: Plug Wallet is a non-custodial multi-chain wallet covering Internet Computer, Bitcoin and EVM chains.
content.description: Plug Wallet is a browser wallet originating in the Internet Computer ecosystem that now also covers Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana and Hyperliquid. Its inpage provider lets applications trigger transfers and transaction requests against a user's wallet. The wallet is built by Funded Labs, which issues migration steps when a release changes the underlying key format.
